items.text: for the time being ill give a thumbs up. that being said if you played neo scavangers you know most of what your getting into. the concept is refreshing and good potential. (yeah how many times have you read that for a early access game). you make some choices of how you character came to be a Scav/wrecker, which matters, from which like all people going out into the world they took on a mortage and bought a ship. the ship and everything in the universe break down and need repairing. salvaging is mostly straight forward, currently a bit difficult in finding leaks, along with getting the money you need to not become a reprobate.
items.text_zh: 暂时我会给个好评。话虽如此，如果你玩过《新拾荒者》，你就知道大部分内容会是什么样。这个概念很清新，潜力也不错。（是啊，你为抢先体验游戏读过多少次这种话了。）你会对角色如何成为拾荒者/拆解者做出一些选择，这些选择很重要，就像所有走向世界的人一样，他们背了房贷并买了一艘船。船以及宇宙中的一切都会损坏，需要修理。打捞基本上很直接，目前找漏点有点困难，同时还要赚到足够的钱，以免沦为堕落之徒。

observations.evidence: currently a bit difficult in finding leaks
observations.evidence_zh: 目前在寻找泄漏点方面有点困难
